**Applied C-e ledger audit (#297) to issue-259-d2 tasks.md — 20 signed-debt marks resolved**

**What**: Applied an externally-completed C-e ledger audit (governance issue #297) to `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/tasks.md`, on branch `feat/issue-259-d2-pr3-net-parity-reverter-skip`. 19 `[x]` marks in Phase 3.1–3.4 flipped to `[ ]` with a `(SIGNED DEBT — impl lives only on archive/d2-pr3-superseded-9233880, never merged to feature/v2.0.0; rebuilt greenfield by PR3)` annotation. 6 marks (2.1.1–2.1.4, 2.2.1, 2.2.2) reworded in place with `[STALE-SUPERSEDED — net-parity, 49fd4dd → 29ca6dc → 5987840]` pointers, left checked. 1 mark (2.2.5) annotated `[C-e AUDIT — false-at-merge, now covered]`, left checked. Total original `[x]` count was exactly 77 (58 remain + 19 unchecked), and 19+1(2.2.5)=20 matches the audit's "20 of 77" finding precisely.

**Why**: PR3's Phase 3.1–3.4 checklist (parse-failures.mjs, `[FAIL-SHA]` emission, `reverterSkipLine`+`isReverterOf` wiring, resolved-skip wiring, `crossCheck`/`crossCheckExit`, `TREE_KEYED_CHECKS`) was marked done, but that implementation exists ONLY on the abandoned mutant commit `9233880` (tag `archive/d2-pr3-superseded-9233880`) and was never merged to `feature/v2.0.0` — PR3 is being rebuilt greenfield onto PR2b's net-parity `resolution.mjs`. Separately, PR2's `changedPaths`/`P ∩ D = ∅` path-set predicate was legitimately superseded by whole-diff-TEXT net-parity (`normDiff`/`netPresent`/`sign`) after judgment-round-1 (#916) found a rename bypass — those marks are still true today, just under new symbols, so they were reworded not unchecked. Phase 2.2.5's claimed A5 fixture was false-at-merge on PR2 (no such fixture existed in `resolution.test.mjs` at merge time, per PR2b's own finding note in tasks.md) but A5 coverage exists today at `resolution.test.mjs:763`.

**Where**: `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/tasks.md` only. Verified against: `git show origin/feature/v2.0.0:brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs` (0 matches for `reverterSkipLine|isReverterOf|TREE_KEYED_CHECKS`, confirms greenfield), `git show origin/feature/v2.0.0:.../parse-failures.mjs` (MISSING — confirms never merged), `git show 9233880:brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs` (27 matches — confirms wiring lives only on the archive tag), `resolution.mjs:140,197,237,269-273` (normDiff/sign/netPresent/isResolvedAt — current net-parity home), `resolution.test.mjs:150,184,763` (F-1 guard test, #916 rename-bypass test as A1's current home, A5 net-parity test).

**Learned**: The 400-changed-line PR budget forced net-parity work (PR2b) to happen as a separate stacked PR reopening PR2's merged `resolution.mjs`, which is why PR3's Phase 3.x checklist predates PR2b and needs a full rebase+rework pass (already flagged in tasks.md as a "DEFERRED REWORK NOTE" with a Phase 3.0 blocking gate for the `reverterSkipLine`→`netAddFull` rewrite, engram #963/#964). Did not touch `brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs` (owned by a concurrent agent this run) or commit/stage anything — all edits left in the working tree per instructions.
